content: J1939TpConnection . receiver reference in case that the destination is connected to a configured J1939NmNode In case that the desti- nation is connected to a configured J1939NmNode , the J1939TpConnection shall reference the J1939TpNode in the role receiver . It means that the receiving J1939TpNode is associated with an EcuInstance via the CommunicationCon- nector and this EcuInstance is associated with a J1939NmNode via the NmEcu . In this case the nmNodeId of the J1939NmNode corresponds to the TpAddress defined by J1939TpNode .
